name: tabiji.ai API
description: Free REST API for AI-curated travel data — destinations, restaurant picks, itineraries, comparisons, and unified search. No API key required.

endpoints.description: All 706 destinations with budget, season, vibes, and travel styles
Full picks guide with all places, ratings, hours, and quotes
Full comparison with structured verdicts, categories, and FAQs
Unified agent-ready catalog spanning destinations and places with provenance/freshness fields
Search destinations and places by natural-language query plus optional structured filters
Apply deterministic hard constraints to the unified catalog
Rank candidates for a trip intent with explanations, tradeoffs, freshness, and provenance

dataSource: Curated from Reddit discussions, enriched with Google Places data (ratings, hours, maps links).
license: Free for non-commercial use. Attribution appreciated: tabiji.ai
